## Description

Proposed nonlinear approach to regime-aware allocation: Infer changing market states from available price, volatility, or macroeconomic signals and vary portfolio exposure by estimated regime; regime labels and transition rules require specification. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
